product.description: The Nexora Mechanical Pro 104 delivers a tactile typing experience for professionals and gamers alike. Featuring 104 keys with PBT keycaps and high‑quality steel stabilizers, the keyboard offers consistent performance over millions of keystrokes. A dual‑mode connection supports both USB‑C and legacy PS/2 interfaces, ensuring compatibility across a wide range of systems. The backlit LEDs provide adjustable brightness and color options, while a robust ABS chassis protects against daily wear. Designed for ergonomic use, the Pro 104 includes a detachable wrist rest and programmable macro keys, making it suitable for long‑form work or intensive gaming sessions.
